caption: Cover page of the transcript of Senate Select Committee proceedings, October 15, 1975, the day of Sidney Gottlieb's testimony.
alt: Photocopied title page reading THE UNITED STATES SENATE, Report of Proceedings, Hearing held before Senate Select Committee to Study Governmental Operations With Respect to Intelligence Activities, Wednesday, October 15, 1975, Washington, D.C., stamped Approved for Release and marked National Security Information.
credit: Ward & Paul (Senate reporting service) / CIA CREST collection, via Internet Archive
